name: AI Prompt Metadata
description: Extends asset metadata with a dedicated Prompt field for recording and searching AI generation prompts.
author: Bowerbird Team
longDescription:
### Key Features
- **Dedicated AI Prompt Field**: Easily record Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, DALL-E, ComfyUI, or custom LLM generation prompts for any image or asset.
- **Compact Height-Capped Read-out**: Long prompts stay inside a fixed-height, scrollable preview so the inspector sidebar never turns into an endless text wall.
- **Expand into a Full Dialog**: One click opens the prompt in a roomy, distraction-free dialog (Esc or backdrop click to close) with its own copy action.
- **One-Click Clipboard Copy**: Copy the full generation prompt at any time, with Copy/Copied feedback and a legacy clipboard fallback.
- **Inspector Integration**: Beautiful, non-intrusive collapsible panel directly in Bowerbird's right inspector sidebar, with auto-save on blur.
- **Searchable Metadata**: Prompts are stored in the asset manifest and seamlessly indexed for keyword search across your entire library.

notes: Header is now icon-free and badge-free: no leading property icon, no character-count badge
Prompt read-out is now height-capped with an Expand dialog for full-length prompts
Copy is a single icon button that swaps to a check mark (Copy/Copied tooltip) with a legacy clipboard fallback
Auto-saving inline editor with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to save and Esc to cancel
Initial official release as a modular metadata extension
Auto-save with character and word counting
Clean Light and Dark mode adaptation
